home.title: RetCalc: Free Retirement Planning Toolkit
home.desc: Free retirement planning toolkit: a calculator, a guide and tools for withdrawals, taxes and more, tested on every market since 1926. No account needed.

calculator.title: Free Retirement Calculator: Will Your Savings Last?
calculator.desc: Free retirement calculator: see if your savings will last, then test withdrawals, taxes, Roth conversions and healthcare. Runs privately in your browser.

advanced.title: Advanced Retirement Calculator: Taxes, Fees & History
advanced.desc: Project retirement savings with fees, account types, employer match and 2026 taxes, then test it against every market since 1926 or 5,000 random ones.

stages.title: Multi-Stage Retirement Savings Calculator | RetCalc
stages.desc: Plan retirement savings in stages, each with its own contribution, raises and return, chained into one projection tested against real market history.

guide.title: Retirement Readiness Check: Are You on Track? | RetCalc
guide.desc: A guided retirement check-up: your number, a readiness score out of 100, and your plan tested against every market since 1926, and the moves that matter.

guide/paycheck.title: Paycheck to Retirement: Take-Home Pay, Budget and Savings Plan | RetCalc
guide/paycheck.desc: Work out your take-home pay after taxes, build your budget, decide where each paycheck goes (401(k), HSA, IRA, brokerage), and see where it gets you by retirement, kids included.

tools.title: Free Financial Planning Calculators | RetCalc
tools.desc: Free calculators for retirement withdrawals, Social Security, Roth conversions, RMDs, healthcare, FIRE, taxes, mortgages, college, budgets and debt.

about.title: About RetCalc: How the Calculators Work
about.desc: How RetCalc's calculators work: where the tax rules and market data since 1926 come from, what each tool assumes, and what it leaves out.

privacy.title: Privacy | RetCalc
privacy.desc: What RetCalc keeps and where: nothing without an account, and only your household, saved scenarios and Guide answers if you choose to sign in. Never sold.

drawdown.title: Drawdown Simulator: Will My Money Last?
drawdown.desc: Test the 4% rule, guardrails and other strategies against every retirement since 1926, with Social Security and pensions. See how often each lasts.

4-percent-rule.title: 4% Rule & Safe Withdrawal Rate Calculator | RetCalc
4-percent-rule.desc: Test the 4% rule against every retirement since 1926: how often it lasted 30, 40 and 50 years, when it failed, and the safe rate for your mix.

guardrails.title: Guyton-Klinger Guardrails Calculator | RetCalc
guardrails.desc: Test Guyton-Klinger guardrails against every retirement since 1926: how much more you can spend at the start, and how often and how deep the cuts came.

vpw.title: VPW Calculator: Variable Percentage Withdrawal | RetCalc
vpw.desc: Variable percentage withdrawal (VPW) tested against every retirement since 1926: each year's payment, how it rises with age and how low it fell.

vanguard-dynamic-spending.title: Vanguard Dynamic Spending Calculator | RetCalc
vanguard-dynamic-spending.desc: Test Vanguard's dynamic spending rule, where spending rises at most 5% and falls at most 2.5% a year, against every retirement since 1926.

risk-based-guardrails.title: Risk-Based Guardrails Calculator | RetCalc
risk-based-guardrails.desc: Risk-based guardrails change spending only when your odds of success leave a band. See how often and how far spending moved since 1926.

rmd-withdrawal-strategy.title: RMD Withdrawal Strategy Calculator | RetCalc
rmd-withdrawal-strategy.desc: Use the IRS life-expectancy table as a spending rule: each year's balance divided by the divisor, tested against every retirement since 1926.

ratcheting-withdrawal.title: Kitces Ratchet Calculator: The 4% Rule With Raises
ratcheting-withdrawal.desc: The Kitces ratchet: start at 4% and raise spending 10% when the portfolio grows 50%. See how often retirees since 1926 got raises, and what it cost.

cape-withdrawal.title: CAPE-Based Withdrawal Rate Calculator | RetCalc
cape-withdrawal.desc: Set your withdrawal rate from the market's CAPE ratio: more when stocks are cheap, less when they're dear. See today's rate and how it did since 1926.

optimizer.title: Retirement Optimizer: Social Security & Roth Conversions
optimizer.desc: When should each of you claim Social Security, which account first, and how much to convert to Roth? Tests thousands of plans in every market since 1926.

bridge.title: Early Retirement Calculator: Reach 59½ Penalty-Free
bridge.desc: Retiring before 59½? Compare a Roth conversion ladder, 72(t) payments, the rule of 55 and brokerage, with 2026 taxes, penalties and ACA premiums.

72t.title: 72(t) Calculator: SEPP Payments Before 59½ | RetCalc
72t.desc: Size 72(t) substantially equal periodic payments from an IRA before 59½ without the 10% penalty, and test them in every market since 1926.

roth.title: Roth Conversion Calculator: Should You Convert? | RetCalc
roth.desc: Test Roth conversion strategies year by year to age 100 with 2026 taxes, Social Security, RMDs and IRMAA. See lifetime tax and after-tax wealth.

rmd.title: RMD Calculator: Required Minimum Distributions by Age
rmd.desc: Project your required minimum distributions to age 100 with the IRS Uniform Lifetime Table, and see if Roth conversions would cut lifetime tax.

healthcare.title: Retirement Healthcare Cost Calculator: ACA & Medicare
healthcare.desc: Estimate retirement health costs: 2026 ACA premiums and subsidies before 65, then Medicare Part B, Part D, Medigap and IRMAA by income.

fire.title: FIRE Calculator & Coast FIRE Calculator | RetCalc
fire.desc: Find your FIRE number and the age you could reach independence, or when you could stop saving with Coast FIRE, on steady or historical returns.

backtest.title: Portfolio Backtest: Stocks, Bonds & Cash Since 1926
backtest.desc: See what any mix of stocks, small-cap value, bonds and cash returned since 1926: real return, volatility, worst year and every rolling 1 to 30-year period.

incometax.title: 2026 Income Tax Calculator: Federal, State & FICA
incometax.desc: Estimate 2026 take-home pay with federal brackets, all 50 states and FICA, or the tax on retirement income from IRAs, Roth, pensions and Social Security.

mortgage.title: Mortgage Calculator With Taxes, PMI & Extra Payments
mortgage.desc: Calculate your full monthly mortgage payment with property tax, insurance, PMI and HOA, then test extra payments, recasting and refinancing.

rentbuy.title: Rent vs. Buy Calculator | RetCalc
rentbuy.desc: Should you rent or buy? Compare renter and buyer net worth year by year, counting down payment, ownership costs, appreciation, selling costs and taxes.

college.title: College Savings Calculator: How Much to Save | RetCalc
college.desc: How much to save each month for college, from public in-state to private schools, with tuition inflation, current savings and 529 growth.

budget.title: Budget Calculator: Income, Spending & Savings | RetCalc
budget.desc: Build a monthly budget line by line and size your emergency fund, then see how each paycheck covers it after taxes and where the rest should go. Export it as a spreadsheet.

debt.title: Debt Payoff Calculator: Avalanche vs. Snowball | RetCalc
debt.desc: List your debts and see your debt-free date, total interest and savings over minimum payments, with avalanche and snowball compared month by month.

social-security.title: Social Security Calculator: Your Benefit at 62, 67 or 70 | RetCalc
social-security.desc: Estimate your Social Security benefit from your pay or your statement, see your check at every age from 62 to 70, break-even ages, and spousal and survivor benefits.
